tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check src/main.ts server.js vite.config.js client/app.js client/pages/name-gen.js client/pages/editor.js && deno test --allow-read=dist,posts,tests --allow-write=tests
tasks.desktop:dev: deno task build && deno desktop --hmr --include posts --allow-env=HOME,XDG_DATA_HOME,LOCALAPPDATA,APPDATA,PORT,DENO_SERVE_ADDRESS --allow-net --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run=zenity,osascript,powershell server.js
tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run --allow-env=PORT --allow-net --allow-read=dist,posts --watch=src/,dist/,posts/ src/main.ts
